rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
(application_duration_seconds<120 OR mouse_events_count=0 OR scroll_events_count=0)
| stats count as app_count dc(applicant_id) as unique_applicants values(applicant_id) as applicants
  avg(application_duration_seconds) as avg_duration min(application_duration_seconds) as min_duration
  sum(mouse_events_count) as total_mouse_events by device_fingerprint ip_address
| where app_count>3 OR (avg_duration<120 AND total_mouse_events=0)
| eval risk_level=case(app_count>10, "critical", app_count>5, "high", app_count>3, "medium")
rules.title: DL-0118: Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect automated circumvention of KYC identity verification processes: (1) liveness check submissions exhibiting synthetic face indicators such as GAN artifacts or uniform skin texture, (2) document p
logsource:
    product: banking
    category: identity_verification
    service: kyc_verification
detection:
    selection_synthetic:
        liveness_synthetic_score|gt: 0.7
    selection_lighting:
        document_lighting_mismatch: true
        selfie_lighting_mismatch: true
    selection_multi_ip:
        identity_multi_ip_count|gt: 2
        ip_geo_dispersion_km|gt: 500
    selection_automation:
        session_interaction_pattern: "automated"
        verification_attempt_count|gte: 3
    condition: selection_synthetic or selection_lighting or selection_multi_ip or selection_automation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0119: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection (Sigma)
